name: git-commit
description: Stage and commit changes with a descriptive message. Verifies that tests pass before committing. Creates an evidence record of the commit hash for provenance tracking.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: The commit message describing the change.

inputs.name: runTestsFirst
inputs.description: If true (default), run the test suite before committing. Abort if tests fail.

outputs.name: commitHash
outputs.description: The SHA of the created commit, for evidence/provenance tracking.

failureConditions.signal: test suite exit code is non-zero
git commit exits with 'nothing to commit'
git command fails with 'not a git repository'
